target_customer: Ohio families who provide unpaid in-home care to a relative and may qualify for Medicaid paid caregiving
problem: Family caregivers do not know how to qualify for Medicaid programs that can pay them, and enrollment, training and billing paperwork is complex.
business_model: Medicaid reimbursed care coordination and services provider paid through Ohio Medicaid programs

founders.name: Anuhya Vajapey
founders.background_notes: Machine learning in healthcare, strategy at McKinsey and product at F5 per the YC page.

founders.name: Juan M Ochoa Ortiz
founders.background_notes: Data science and software roles per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly intake, eligibility and billing workflows. The hard part is operational and regulatory rather than technical.

defensibility.rationale: Provider certification and payer relationships help, but several providers offer the same Ohio service.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Other Ohio providers offer structured family caregiving. Sources date the Ohio program launch to late 2024, after founding.

market_need_then: Many Ohio families provide unpaid care and Ohio Medicaid waivers can pay relatives. A 2026 report says the Ohio House considered banning such payments, a policy risk.

branding.domain_note: Uses thecareoasis.com, with a the prefix.

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand was found. The name is easily confused with Oasis home care providers.

outcome_analysis: CareOasis is a two person company serving Ohio only, with a live site in 2026 and no verified funding after YC. Its fate depends on Ohio Medicaid policy and competition from other structured family caregiving providers. No clear success or failure story is public.
notes: Funding figures conflict: a Signalbase page lists 100K pre-seed published March 2026 with no investors, CB Insights lists a pre-seed in September 2023 with Y Combinator and SBXi, PitchBook via a directory says 500K, and Latka says bootstrapped. All are aggregators and unverified, so no round is recorded. Ohio program launch is dated late 2024 by sources, so no 2023 competitors were found and the list is empty. No education was found for the founders.
